legend: A keratotic nodule is present on the scalp.

legend: The epidermal lesion shows hyperkeratosis, papillomatosis, and inward proliferation of the rete ridges.
Higher-magnification view highlighting the hypergranulosis and koilocytosis.

Papillomatous exophytic epidermal proliferation. Orthokeratosis and marked acanthosis. Hypergranulosis and prominent keratohyalin-like granules of variable size within the granular layer. Compact hyperkeratosis with vertical columns of round parakeratosis. Infolding of elongated rete ridges towards base. Koilocytes are observed within or below the granular layer. Slight inflammation of the underlying papillary dermis.
